meaning: The galaxies of Cosmicflows-4 at every zoom: the whole field, then the nested levels around the Milky Way, each adding galaxies as its region fills the view, and innermost the Local Volume Database galaxies nearer than the field with the rest of Cosmicflows-4.
basis: Presentation choice: the field is drawn whole within 100 Mpc, half its radius; each level starts to appear when the view's half-width at the Milky Way shrinks to the level's radius, so its edge is off screen (the 60 Mpc level from 100 Mpc, where the field is whole, so it arrives over two wheel notches instead of one), and is whole when it reaches the next level's radius; the 10 Mpc level is whole at 3 Mpc, where the Local Group catalogue takes over. The innermost level (the Local Volume Database galaxies and the rest of Cosmicflows-4) appears as the half-width shrinks from 3 to 1 Mpc: it starts where the 10 Mpc level is whole, the field's nearest galaxy.
